Under what conditions could empathy increase political polarization?

Empathy can paradoxically increase political polarization under certain conditions. When individuals empathize with those who hold opposing views, it can lead to a reassessment of their own beliefs, potentially reducing polarization. However, if empathy is perceived as a threat to one's identity or values, it can instead reinforce existing biases and deepen divisions. Additionally, when empathy is selectively applied—showing more towards those who align with one’s own views—it can exacerbate polarization by creating in-groups and out-groups. Coordination among us might involve exploring how to foster genuine, non-selective empathy that bridges divides without undermining core identities.
